review_evidence: README describes Batteries as the extended “batteries included” Lean library for both computer-science and mathematics applications.
The hydrated snapshot has 260 Lean files and direct scan found roughly 1,389 theorem declarations plus hundreds of checked examples across production modules.

For example Batteries/Classes/Order.lean develops Lawful comparison/order interfaces and transitivity/equivalence theorems, showing that the source contains reusable formal specifications and proofs rather than only runtime utilities.
summary: Retain Batteries as a large theorem-bearing foundational library of data structures, algebraic/order interfaces, algorithms, tactics, and proved laws.

review_evidence: Surveyed the checkout root (`find . -maxdepth 1`): `Batteries/` and `BatteriesTest/` are the Lean source directories in scope; `scripts/` holds maintenance tooling; `lakefile.toml`, `lake-manifest.json`, `lean-toolchain`, `bors.toml`, `.gitpod.yml`, `README.md`, `LICENSE` are non-Lean/out-of-scope files (no `lakefile.lean` present).

Ran a Lean declaration-marker grep (theorem|lemma|def |structure|inductive|class |instance|abbrev|macro|elab|syntax|axiom) across all 24 files: scores ranged from 0 (5 files) to 297 (`Data/List/Lemmas.lean`).

Read all 5 zero-hit files in full: `Batteries.lean` (5336 bytes, ~120 `public`/`public meta import` lines only), `Classes/SatisfiesM.lean` (229 bytes, 3 imports plus a `deprecated_module` module-level notice), `Data/MLList.lean` (141 bytes, 3 imports), `Lean/Except.lean` (225 bytes, 2 imports), `Recycling/MonadSatisfying.lean` (292 bytes, 5 imports) -- all pure import aggregators with zero declarations, consistent with this session's FILTER-007 root/sub-aggregator precedent; the vast majority of their import targets (e.g. `Batteries.Classes.Cast`, `.Data.Array`, `.Tactic.Lint`, `.Data.MLList.Basic`) are pre-existing files outside this unit's 24-file diff. All retained (FILTER-007 does not authorize exclusion).

Read `CodeAction/Basic.lean` in full (3041 bytes, 1 hit): a real `def tacticCodeActionProvider` implementing an IDE hole/tactic code-action provider, imported by `Batteries.lean` itself as a shipped library feature (not a standalone external tool) -- genuine library source, retained.

Read `scripts/check_imports.lean` in full (6782 bytes, 12 hits): a repository-maintenance script (`checkBatteriesDataImports`, `checkBatteriesDataDir`, `addModulesIn`, `writeImportModule`, etc.) that verifies and can autofix the `Batteries.lean` import tree against the `Batteries/Data/` directory structure -- meta-programming CI tooling inspecting the module graph, zero domain-mathematical declarations, matching this session's established CI-tooling exclusion precedent (powdr-labs__apc-optimizer's `Scripts/CheckAxioms.lean`/`Scripts/UnusedTheorems.lean`).

Read all 5 `BatteriesTest/` files in full: `ImportLean.lean`/`ImportLeanExplicit.lean` (meta-vs-runtime-import boundary tests with real `def foo`/`meta def elaboratedExpr`), `alias.lean` (extensive `alias`/`theorem`/`def`/`axiom` test fixture exercising the `alias` tactic across deprecation, protected, noncomputable, and unsafe cases), `except.lean` (a `DecidableEq (Except _ _)` instance-absence regression check), `simpa.lean` (a `simpa`/`simp` linter test fixture with real theorems including `div_left_injective`, `Prod.mk.inj_iff`) -- all hold genuine formal declarations exercising real tactics/instances, consistent with this session's precedent that a documented test fixture containing real declarations is not excludable under FILTER-002/004.
